ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (23) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Осуждать» (osuzhdat', 'condemn') is 'condemn' throughout, and Matthew 7:1–5 is translated from Tolstoy's Russian wording («сучок», suchok, 'twig'; «бревно», brevno, 'log'), as in the February files. In passage 4 «произведена вражда» (proizvedena vrazhda) is 'enmity has been produced', keeping the arithmetic image of the product; Epictetus's «заблуждение» (zabluzhdenie) is 'error', and the attribution «Б.» (B.) is kept as the bare initial the print gives.
